name: book_airport_car
description: Book the hotel car to the airport for an in-house guest: flat eighty-five dollars to SFO, seats up to four with luggage, charged to the room. (Taxis are hailed at the door, metered roughly fifty-five to seventy dollars, and can't be reserved ahead - cost comparison in lookup_policy topic "location_and_transport".) Sanity-check the pickup time against the flight when you know it - about three hours before departure is right for international.

pickup_date.description: Pickup date in ISO YYYY-MM-DD format. Resolve a weekday against today and confirm the concrete date with the caller before booking.
pickup_date.title: Pickup Date

pickup_time.description: Pickup time in 24-hour HH:MM format (2:30 p.m. = "14:30").
pickup_time.title: Pickup Time

passengers.description: How many people are riding - ASK the caller; never assume one.
passengers.title: Passengers
